latestVersion.changelog:
ai-dog-openapi-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release: AI pet portrait generator using WeShop OpenAPI
- Create or transform pet photos with an optional image and descriptive text prompt
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication (never share your key outside openapi.weshop.ai)
- Supports generating up to 16 images per request and uploading user images for transformation
- Includes instructions for obtaining and securing your API key
